name: Peptide Folding MD Benchmark
description: Benchmarks accelerated molecular dynamics protocols by measuring peptide folding behavior across combinations of force fields and explicit solvent models.
evaluation_method: RMSD and folding success rate (e.g., fraction of trajectories reaching native state); comparative metrics across force fields/solvents
general_score_metric: RMSD (root-mean-square deviation) and folding success rate
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used in computational chemistry and molecular dynamics to compare accelerated MD protocols; well regarded within the niche of MD method development but not widely used outside that community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results strongly depend on force field, solvent model, and simulation length; computationally expensive; sensitive to simulation setup and potential dataset/model-specific biases.
